scientific_integrity: The mathematical proof uses character decompositions and inequalities; finite symbolic and quadrature tests are supporting checks, not substitutes for all-rank proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the three-dimensional central span of 1, a symmetric-power SU(N) character, and its contragredient for N>=3; no claims for arbitrary packets or higher moments. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed literature, and independent assessment is outstanding.
title: Sharp dual-symmetric-power character moments and the rank-three mixing transition
